purpose: Discovery and mandatory collision-check baseline for Super Power maintenance. This is not a complete universe of all JCB Power repositories.
ordering: Listed in the order supplied by the project owner. Runtime resolution must use the consuming JCB installation's configured order, including authorized additional repositories.
identity_policy: Preserve existing GUIDs. For a genuinely new power, generate UUIDv4 with a cryptographically secure generator and check current registered indexes, task-specific indexes, and local uncommitted additions. Example identities are reserved fixtures and must not be reused.

repositories.description: Central shared foundation and reference standard for JCB-owned reusable classes, interfaces, abstractions, utilities and service providers. Search this after Joomla core/framework and before specialist implementations.
Search and replacement infrastructure expressed as Super Powers.
PSR-related contracts represented as Super Powers; preserve upstream attribution and semantics.
Cryptography and file-transfer integration, including Composer-backed phpseclib wrappers.
OpenAI client, service providers, endpoint classes and utilities. Existing specimens demonstrate structure, not endorsement of current API coverage.
Gitea client, endpoint classes, service providers and utilities.
Minification and path-conversion powers adapted from upstream projects; preserve their licensing and compatibility.
